title: Twin Cast: Refirement Instead of Retirement
description:
On the Twin Cast podcast, Kirk McCarley shares why he doesn’t believe in traditional retirement — he calls it “refirement.”

Instead of slowing down, he focused on what his next chapter would look like. After exploring different paths like ministry, teaching, and therapy, he realized coaching was the right fit.

His perspective is a reminder that life after a career isn’t about stopping — it’s about finding purpose and continuing to grow.

Follow for more Twin Cast conversations, career coaching insights, and real-life lessons.
